description: the Shield of the World, a primordial titan who guards the whole world, far larger than any knight, armour of white stone and gold carved like the walls and towers of a great gord with glowing golden runes, a gigantic round shield that is the world itself, its lands and seas shining in emerald green and azure inside a golden rim, a vast dome of golden light arching behind her like a gate of heaven, close to the body, white stone towers rising from her shoulders, eyes glowing white-gold, holding a stone warhammer with golden runes, a palette of ivory stone, gold, emerald and azure; adult woman, light skin, dark brown hair tied back in a high ponytail, a strong determined face, an open helmet, her face clearly visible, well lit and well drawn, with distinct eyes, eyebrows, nose and mouth, not in shadow; standing in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet, with everything around it, inside the image, the figure about four fifths of the image height, empty space on every side, nothing touching the edges of the image, highly detailed pixel art with fine details, rich textures and ornaments, crisp clean outlines, mythic, overwhelming and radiant, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
